name: Blendful (alpha)
author: xpilot
description: Port of sunnypilot Blendful (#2073, alpha): nudges the model's path toward the lane center when the lane lines are clear, and backs off when lines fade, the model goes around something, or during a lane change or turn. The correction builds at most 0.5 m/s^2 per second; the host caps it at 0.5 m/s^2 and SP's curvature limits still apply. Works with laneless models, not with lateral controller plugins that ignore the desired curvature.
